questions.question:
Directions: In each of the following questions, select one alternative in which the third statement is implied by the first two statements.

All elephants are wild, All lions are wild. So all lions are elephant
options: All elephants are wild, All lions are wild. So all lions are elephant
All mangoes are red, Some apples are mangoes. So, all apples are red
All roads are boxes, All foxes are roads. So, all boxes are foxes
All XYZ can run, All ABC are XYZ. So, all ABC can run.
questions.answer: All XYZ can run, All ABC are XYZ. So, all ABC can run.
